No physical recognition/calibration approval.", "actual_phase_choices": []}], "source_limit": "Introduced symmetric Earth section: inner zone has two cross-section lobes and outer zone two lobes, TWO particle populations rather than four separate physical belts. Central circle is Earth reference. Ten sparse9mm ring-shaped particle glyphs identify trapped populations; their counts/sizes/spacing are nonliteral and not individual-particle positions, measured density or real belt dimensions. Closed outlines delimit schematic population envelopes, not solid rings/shells/ozone or magnetic field lines. Both left and right zones retain actual finite gaps; no mission dose or permanent universal intensity/shape. Source1387 two illustrated views are one programme, no exact unread source labels recovered. Nominal illustrative600x440mm, not physical page/devicefit.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}
